known_environment_boundary.finding: All pinned SHA-256 values are of LF bytes, and the runner hashes on-disk bytes at runtime. Commit does not rewrite the working tree, so the current tree still matches every pin (verified before and after Commit A). However, a fresh clone or a hard re-checkout on Windows under core.autocrlf=true would materialise CRLF and would fail these pins.
known_environment_boundary.action_required_before_execution_on_a_fr: Confirm on-disk line endings match the pins, or add a .gitattributes eol policy under a separately authorized change.
